data.name: Melusina
data.gender_notes: Melusina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In medieval European folklore, Melusina was a water nymph who was half-human and half-serpent. Her name derives from the Latin mellus, meaning 'honey,' and sineo, meaning 'to flow.' Melusina was a protectress of wild animals and a guardian of forests, rivers, and springs. The name Melusina carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Melusina usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine feminine and the power of nature
data.etymology: Melusina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Melusina total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: מלוסינה
in_hebrew.meaning: מלוסינה היא שם שפירושו מלוסין או שירית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מלוסינה היא שם שמקורו אינו ברור, אך ייתכן שמקורו במילה היוונית 'מלוס', שפירושו תפוח. שם זה אינו מוזכר ישירות בכתבי הקודש העבריים, אך הוא עשוי להיות קשור למושגים של פריון וצמיחה. השם מלוסינה משמש לעתים קרובות בקשרים נוצריים, אך אין לו קשר ישיר למסורת היהודית.

in_greek.name: Μελουσίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Μελουσίνα είναι ένα όνομα που πιθανότατα προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'μέλος', που σημαίνει τραγούδι ή μέλος. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, τα ονόματα που σχετίζονται με τη μουσική και το τραγούδι συχνά συνδέονται με την πνευματική επαφή με το Θεό. Το όνομα Μελουσίνα μπορεί να συμβολίζει μια ψυχή που τραγουδάει με αγάπη και ευχαριστία.

data.cultural_impact: Melusina's legend served as a popular theme in European literature and art, emphasizing the conflicting aspects of beauty and danger present in nature and the power of water. Her story was often used in medieval tales to explore themes of transformation, loyalty, and the supernatural.
data.spiritual_significance: Melusina represents the enchanting power of nature and the delicate balance between human prowess and the whims of the natural world. Her domestic harmony with human husband Renaud despite her serpentine nature highlights the potential for unity between opposing forces. Melusina's story serves as a reminder of our innate connection to the natural world and inspires reverence for its transformative power.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Melusina is a water nymph in European folklore, embodying the enchanting and mysterious allure of natural waters. Her name symbolizes the transformative power of love and water, as she could only reveal her true beauty to her husband when he pledged never to watch her in the water.

historical_references.reference: Melusina is identified with the Celtic goddess Melusine, who is believed to have been a water nymph or mermaid. Her legend is closely associated with the Loire Valley in France, where she is said to have lived in a castle with her human husband, Gilles de Rais. The tale of Melusina's transformation into a serpent-tailed mermaid is first recorded in the 15th century.

Another version of the Melusina legend comes from the German region of Swabia, where she is known as Melusine von der Saale. In this account, she is described as a sorceress who vowed to curse any man who looked upon her while she was bathing. Her curse was broken by a Bavarian knight named Dietherich, who saved her from a dragon and fell in love with her. Melusina eventually bore him a son, whom she raised as a knight before disappearing into the forest.

modern_usage.modern_context: Melusina is a water nymph or mermaid from European folklore, often depicted as a beautiful woman with the tail of a serpent or fish. In modern contexts, Melusina is a popular figure in various media and artistic expressions. On Twitter, she is often used as a hashtag (#Melusina) to discuss folklore, mythology, and mermaid stories. On Instagram, Melusina is a common theme for artists to create and share their illustrations, paintings, and photographs. DeviantArt is a platform where many artists have dedicated galleries to their Melusina-inspired works.
